tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rta mgrin yab yum gyi lus dkyil bzhugs so:

pad ma dbang gi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: thugs dam rta phag lus dkyil 'di: sgrub thabs gsol 'debs bstod pa phyogs gcig bstan: rig rtsal ngar dang ldan pas 'di ltar bsgom: oṃ mi gnas mi dmigs chos sku de bzhin nyid: āḥkun snang kun khyab 'gro la snying rje bsgom: hūm̐ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med 'phrin las kyis: hrīḥthabs shes nyi zla rtog med bam gyi steng : skad cig rang rig rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal: pad ma rā ga'i mdog ltar sku mdog dmar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum bskrad: ral pa kham nag gyen brdzes spyi bo'i gtsug: rta mgo ljang zhur rngog ma leb rgan 'bar: drag po'i rta skad khams gsum dbang du sdud: spyan bgrad ljags 'dril mche gtsigs hūm̐ sgra sgrogs: gri gug thod khrag kha ṭ+wāṃ phyag na bsnams: 'gying zhing brjid ldan sku che yan lag rags: dpal gyi dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs: 'jigs byed gtum drag dbang gi cha lugs can: sna tshogs thabs ldan 'bar ba'i gar dgur rol: g.yon na rdo rje phag mo bde gshegs yum: sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis yab la 'khril: spyi gtsug phag zhal mthing kha ngur sgra sgrogs: gcer bu spyan gsum mche gtsigs dbu skra grol: bcu drug lang tsho bha ga nu ma rgyas: phyag g.yas gri gug yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: g.yon pas dung dmar stob cing kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: rus rgyan me long dril bu'i rgyan cha 'khrol: 'od zer rdo rje'i tsha tsha skar ltar 'khrugs: ye shes me 'bar rdo rje'i gur khang bzhugs: de nyid spyi gtsug nyi zla pad ma'i steng : bla ma kun bzang che mchog he ru ka: rdo rje dril 'dzin gnyis med yum dang sbyor: kun tu bzang po khro mo gnam zhal ma: rdo rje thod khrag bsnams nas yab dang 'khril: gcer bu gzi mdangs bde bas gang ba'i sku: nam mkha'i mdog can sgeg zhal mnyen lcugs ldan:

gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'od zer 'phro: rin chen rus rgyan cod pan du mas mdzes: tsit+ta'i nang na zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis: dung khang nang na 'bar ba lnga bcu brgyad: bdag nyid lus la ḍāk+ki yab yum lnga: grangs can grangs med gtso 'khor tshul du gsal: ye nas rang yin 'dzin med rang gsal gdab: bla ma rang rig rang gsal kun tu bzang : bde chen rnam dag spros bral kun bzang mo: skye 'gag 'gyur med mnyam nyid chos kyi sku: 'gyur med thag chod dpa' bo shes rab ma: rang byung rang shar cing yang ston cing sprul: lhun grub 'du 'bral med pa a la la: snang srid rnam dag de la rang lus rdzogs: ye shes sku mchog de la phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ āḥhūm̐ oṃ āḥhūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ: hrī ma ha ri ni sa: ra tsa hrī ya: tsit+ta hring hring dza dzaḥ skal ldan snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: : rta mgrin yab yum gyi lus dkyil/ PAGE - PAGE 85 -- PAGE 84 -
